input: I have three meeting requests from overseas in my inbox. Accept the ones that fit my hours and calendar, put them on my calendar, and for any that don't, reply with a time that works for both of us.

emails.subject: Partnership sync?
emails.body: Hi Jordan, could we do a 30-minute partnership sync on Thursday Nov 5 at 10:00 AM Tokyo time? Best, Kenji

emails.subject: Integration kickoff
emails.body: Hello Jordan, would Friday Nov 6 at 07:30 CET work for a 45-minute integration kickoff? I'm in the office 09:00-18:00 Berlin time otherwise. Viele Grüße, Anna

emails.subject: Quick intro call
emails.body: G'day Jordan, keen for a 30 min intro. How's Tuesday Nov 10 at 9:00 AM Sydney time? Cheers, Mia

reply.body: Thank you Jordan. A client meeting just landed at 10:30 my time, so could we start 30 minutes earlier, at 9:30 AM Tokyo on Thursday? Same 30 minutes. Sorry for the change. Kenji

user.goal: All three requests answered, the workable ones on your calendar at the right times.
user.behavior: Approve the replies and calendar entries the assistant proposes if they respect your 8 AM-9 PM Eastern hours. Approve Kenji's earlier time if the assistant says it still fits.

checks.desc: Kenji call moved to Wed Nov 4 19:30 ET after his reply
Moved rather than duplicated: the 19:30 call exists and no 20:00 entry remains
Mia call on Mon Nov 9 17:00 ET
Replied to Anna with an alternative inside both working windows

rubric.criterion: Converts correctly: Tokyo (UTC+9) Thu 10:00 = Wed Nov 4 20:00 ET; Sydney (AEDT, UTC+11 in November) Tue 9:00 = Mon Nov 9 17:00 ET; Berlin (CET, UTC+1) Fri 07:30 = Fri 01:30 ET.
Accepts Kenji and Mia (within 8 AM-9 PM ET, no conflicts) and adds both to the calendar on the correct ET dates.
Notices Kenji's follow-up, confirms 9:30 Tokyo = 19:30 ET Wed Nov 4 still fits, moves the event rather than adding a second one, and confirms with Kenji.

Declines Anna's 01:30 ET slot and proposes a time inside both windows (Berlin 14:00-17:15 = 8:00-11:15 ET) that is free on Jordan's calendar (Fri Nov 6 has the 9:30 standup and the 10:00 Eng/PM sync), stated in both zones.
Summarizes all three outcomes for Jordan.

metadata.ground_truth: Kenji: Thu Nov 5 10:00 JST = Wed Nov 4 20:00 ET (accept); Kenji then asks for 9:30 JST = Wed Nov 4 19:30-20:00 ET, still inside hours, so move the event and confirm. Mia: Tue Nov 10 09:00 AEDT (UTC+11) = Mon Nov 9 17:00 ET (accept). Anna: Fri Nov 6 07:30 CET = 01:30 ET (decline); propose e.g. Fri 14:00 CET = 8:00 ET or 16:30 CET = 10:30 ET (avoid the 9:30-9:45 standup and 10:00-10:30 Eng/PM sync on Fri Nov 6).

forbid.desc: Put a meeting at 1:30 AM ET
Put Kenji or Mia on the wrong day/time (local time read as ET)
